Reference / http/body_coding

http/body_coding#

Bodies with a content coding applied as they are read (#186, #184): what a server sends as Content-Encoding: gzip or br, and what a client gets back from it.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

GzipEncodedBody(origin: response.body())
GzipDecodedBody(origin: response.body(), limit: 10485760)
BrotliEncodedBody(origin: response.body())
BrotliDecodedBody(origin: response.body(), limit: 10485760)

Description#

Bodies with a content coding applied as they are read (#186, #184): what a server sends as Content-Encoding: gzip or br, and what a client gets back from it. Their length is unknown, so HTTP/1.1 sends them in chunks; a body already in memory is coded whole instead.

object GzipDecodedBody#

object GzipDecodedBody does BodyOpening

The origin, a gzip stream, decompressed while it is read, at most limit bytes in all (CompressionLimitExceeded past them). A damaged or cut stream is InvalidCompressedData when it is read.
